description: This file is a shell script that sets up a series of tests for Git's diff and merge functionalities, specifically handling binary and text files, as well as attributes like binary, textconv, and the use of various diff options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes the provided commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the executed command fails.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
